title: In the Quiet Corners of Your World

content:
She wished to walk beside you,
if only for a little while,
following the rhythm of your footsteps,
adoring the path you chose,
though she knew
you walked at a different pace.

She could sense the rhythm of your days,
read the silence between your words,
notice the unspoken in your gestures,
recognise the tremor in your voice,
and feel the pain you never spoke of.
Yet, her heart quietly questioned
whether she had ever understood
the person behind it all.

She had a thousand little things to tell you,
fragments of her day,
thoughts that waited for your ears,
moments she wished to share.
Yet, she gathered her words,
offering only a little,
keeping the rest quietly within.
She knew there were other things on
that needed your time.

She had hours to listen to your stories,
but was content with a few highlights,
finding joy even in those little glimpses.
For she knew
the value of your time.

Because you were her world.

Your day became her day,
your words, her strength,
your touch, her healing,
your pain, her own,
and your smile
the happiness she carried within.

She tried to keep things right for you,
even when her own world
was falling out of place.
Yet, she knew
you were trying too,
in your own little ways,
to keep her happy.

She had desires
that never found their way into words,
little dreams she quietly folded away,
standing beside you,
knowing that you, too,
had set aside pieces of yourself
for the sake of the family.

And perhaps,
all she ever wished for
was not to change your pace,
nor to hold you back,
but simply to walk beside you.

To be heard,
even when she had little to say.
To be remembered,
even in the busiest hours.
To feel that somewhere
within the world you carried,
there was a little corner
that belonged to her.

For while you were living your day,
she was quietly making
a world out of yours.
